C.T. Carter, one of our first year runners, was entrusted with the last stage … there was little to worry about … we placed fifth, a creditable performance.

Over the last lap Arthur drew away, and although Jack seemed to gain a little in the last fifty yards, Penny won by a few yards in the Club record time of 15min. 6sec. C.T. Carter ran well to finish third and would have been much nearer the leaders but for an attack of “stitch” over the last two laps.
